comments.author: Bey Galang
comments.content: Editing my 5 star review to 1 star after only using it ONCE. This is the first and probably the last time I’ll be purchasing a powerbank from Ugreen. I honestly expected it to be good, but after only using it once— like literally for 1 charge, it seems it’s not really that great. I fully charged my powerbank when it arrived and since I am a homebody, this is my first time using it. I started charging my phone around 4:45-4:50PM and noticed how FAST my powerbank’s battery was decreasing. My phone’s not even at 50% yet and the powerbank was already at 93% from 100%. As it continued to charge, it continues to decrease more. It’s like it lessens 1-3% of its charge per 4-5% of the charge on my phone. I didn’t get to fully charge my phone, but the powerbank is now only at 82%— after only charging 1 device that did not even reach full charge. CS tells me that this is normal, but for a 20,000mAh powerbank, I definitely know it’s not normal considering I’ve had a couple of 20kMAH powerbanks before.
